name: Restart a service
summary: Restarts one named service and confirms it is running again: a Windows service, a systemd unit, or a macOS launchd system daemon.
risk_note: Whatever the service does is interrupted while it restarts, and on Windows services that depend on it are restarted with it. A disabled or masked service is refused rather than started. The mustra agent's own service is refused too: restarting it would end this job before it could report.

windows: Restarts the service with that name (or, failing that, that display name) and starts again any dependent service that was running.
Refuses a disabled service, a name with wildcard characters, and the mustra agent.
linux: Runs systemctl restart on the unit (.service is assumed when no suffix is given) and checks it is active afterwards; uses service or rc-service where systemd is not running.
Refuses a unit that does not exist or is masked, and the mustra agent.
darwin: Runs launchctl kickstart -k on the launchd system daemon with that label (for example com.openssh.sshd).
Refuses a label that is not loaded in the system domain, and the mustra agent.

parameters.name: service
parameters.label: Service name (Windows service, systemd unit or launchd label)
